archiveProvenance.sanitization: Bounded diagnostic facts only; provider instructions, headers, cookies, browser storage, and raw message streams are excluded.

coverage: 6/6 assigned status descriptors generated by the production agent and rendered

acceptedCases.condition: A real bound London-to-Paris scope for 15 January 2030 returned zero rows with incomplete coverage.
acceptedCases.reason: It distinguishes missing synthetic coverage from real-world unavailability and correctly omits RetryAction because no local operation failed.

acceptedCases.condition: A DateWindow extension produced four real aborted local query requests while older committed results stayed visible.
acceptedCases.reason: The inline error explains that prior results may not match current filters; clicking Retry issued two local queries, issued no chat request, and recovered successfully.

acceptedCases.condition: Four real DateWindow refresh requests were deliberately held pending while the accepted scene rendered.
acceptedCases.reason: The loading placeholder is clear and responsive, but it remained visible after the held requests completed, so the authored descriptor does not clear automatically when readiness changes.

acceptedCases.condition: The user supplied an old saved comparison and asked to compare it with a newly bound current-date scope; the stale panel was explicitly separated from live fares.
acceptedCases.reason: The generated preview labels only the old saved panel stale and keeps current bounded fares live. Two genuine automatic revision-supersession attempts timed out, so adaptive stale handling remains unverified.

failedAttempts.outcome: A newer browser edit injected after prompt submission produced no terminal accepted scene within 600 seconds.
A completed newer local date edit before the prompt produced no terminal accepted scene within 600 seconds.
The model correctly avoided marking live fares stale and used Callout instead of StaleBadge; this is a valid negative result and does not count as StaleBadge coverage.
Three HTTP 200 chat responses were observed, but the turn stayed nonterminal and was stopped after an alternate honest prompt succeeded.

limitations: ArtifactSkeleton and StaleBadge are authored static status widgets; neither descriptor observes readiness or revision state on its own.
StaleBadge direct generation is proven only for a clearly labelled user-provided old saved comparison. Automatic stale-revision recovery is not proven.
The single 404 console warning in accepted cases is the known generic asset warning; injected query failures are separately listed in the failure case warnings.
